title.en: Logic is placed in the application, not the view

summary.en: PHP embedded in a non-PHP file, or a database query, an env() call or a raw superglobal in a view, mixes logic into what a page shows.

en: Some logic was about to sit in a page's markup.
I am moving it out, so the page stays about what it shows.
fr: De la logique allait se trouver dans le balisage d'une page.
Je la sors, pour que la page reste ce qu'elle affiche.

reason.en: Logic was found in the markup: PHP embedded in a non-PHP file, or a database query (DB::, a model query, new PDO), an env() call or a raw request superglobal in a view. Move it into the application, pass the view only the data it renders, and read configuration and requests there. Template helpers a view is meant to call are left alone.
